svg.title: Daily GPP, TER and NEE from 14 days before to 28 days after a silage harvest, all 20 used episodes of the four sites together, in percent of the mean GPP of the 14 days before the harvest; mean and ± 1 SD over the episodes.
svg.desc: One panel. X axis: days from the first day of the harvest (−14 to +28, local days, UTC+2). Y axis: GPP, TER and NEE in percent of the mean GPP of the days −14 to −1 before the harvest, from −125 to 225 % (NEE in percent of the GPP before: NEE < 0 = uptake, NEE % = TER % − GPP %). Lines: GPP light blue solid with circles, TER light pink dashed with squares, NEE steel blue dash-dotted with triangles; markers every 7 days. The band around each line is the mean ± 1 SD over the episodes; line and band are drawn only where 2 or more episodes have a value. An orange vertical line marks day 0 (the first day of the harvest), thin lines mark 100 % and 0, a dotted grey line marks 80 % (the recovery level). All sites (n = 20; 19 to 20 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −48 % (SD 24, n 20), ΔTER −2 % (SD 26, n 20), ΔNEE 46 % (SD 29, n 20). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14: GPP 52 %, TER 58 %, NEE 7 %; days +15 to +28: GPP 72 %, TER 61 %, NEE −11 %.
